about: Type-a-Grill eval set v1 (drafted by Jr, Nov 23 2026 — Haleem to correct expected configs against the real builder schema). Each case: a customer-style prompt and the config a correct parser must produce. Score = exact match on every field; overrides must match per tooth. 'flag' cases test the validation loop: the correct behavior is to flag/ask, not guess.

cases.prompt: 6x6 all open faced
cases.tests: baseline shorthand, NxN means both arches; metal unspecified stays null

cases.prompt: bottom 8 in 14k yellow gold, solid
cases.tests: single arch only, top must be null

cases.prompt: i want a full set, top and bottom 8, silver
cases.tests: full set phrasing, default finish solid when none named

cases.prompt: top 6 iced out with diamonds
cases.tests: iced out implies stones field populated with diamond

cases.prompt: just fangs, 10k yellow
cases.tests: fangs = top canines only, teeth count 2

cases.prompt: bottom six rose gold
cases.tests: rose gold with no karat stated defaults to 10k_rose — FLAG: confirm this default with Haleem

cases.prompt: 8 on top all opal inlay, white gold 14k
cases.tests: opal inlay puts opal in stones

cases.prompt: can i get windows on the top 6, 18k
cases.tests: question form is still an order; 18k with no color defaults yellow — FLAG: confirm default

cases.prompt: top 8 rose gold, bottom 8 yellow gold, both 14k solid
cases.tests: different metals per arch, shared karat and finish stated once

cases.prompt: bottom six silver and the top rose gold
cases.tests: the example Haleem gave: count stated once (six) applies to both arches

cases.prompt: make the canines open face, rest of the top 8 solid 14k yellow
cases.tests: the other example Haleem gave: per-tooth exception inside a uniform arch

cases.prompt: full set 6x6 iced out but keep the bottom plain gold 14k
cases.tests: 'but' clause overrides one arch of a full-set statement; plain gold = solid, yellow default

cases.prompt: top 6 white gold iced, bottom 6 white gold with opals in the front four
cases.tests: front four opals reads as the arch finish being opal inlay across the visible set — FLAG: per-tooth vs whole-arch reading

cases.prompt: i want the kim k ones. bottom 6 silver iced out with the white opals in the middle
cases.tests: iced out + opal combined finish (the MAG-169 combo); reference to a celebrity set must not invent a top arch

cases.prompt: 8 bottom, diamond dust finish, 10k yellow. nothing on top
cases.tests: explicit negation of the other arch

cases.prompt: top six, all 14k yellow, fangs on the canines and a cross cutout on one front tooth
cases.tests: fang as per-tooth override, cutout as an extra, 'one front tooth' does not specify which — parser should still place the extra at arch level

cases.prompt: perm style. top 8 bottom 8 all 18k yellow solid with my initials engraved
cases.tests: slang 'perm style' = full permanent set; engraving extra on both arches — FLAG: engraving text itself is missing info, parser should note initials not provided

cases.prompt: just the front 4 on top, rubies set in 14k yellow
cases.tests: stones without iced_out: stones present, finish stays solid with stone setting — FLAG: confirm how the builder represents set stones

cases.prompt: bottom 10 silver, top 10 silver, both open face except the front two on top keep those solid
cases.tests: exception scoped to one arch only; bottom must NOT inherit the override

cases.prompt: 6 on the bottom in rose gold but make the two middle ones white gold
cases.tests: per-tooth METAL override (not finish), 'two middle' = front two

cases.prompt: top eight 14k white gold all solid except the back ones make those windows
cases.tests: 'back ones' = the teeth outside the front 4 on an 8 set, override key back_teeth

cases.prompt: can i do 6 on top in silver and add a pink coat
cases.tests: PVD color coat as extra (the Trax +$35 feature); base metal still silver

cases.prompt: bottom 8 yellow gold iced out but no diamonds, use moissanite
cases.tests: iced out with a non-diamond stone named explicitly; moissanite must land in stones, and yellow gold defaults 10k — FLAG: stones enum needs moissanite added

cases.prompt: ok so top: 8 teeth 14k rose. bottom: 6 teeth silver. top canines fangs, everything else solid, and put opals in the top front 2 only
cases.tests: structured multi-clause prompt; stones scoped to front two only via override, must not leak to whole arch

cases.prompt: full set 16 and 16, top half yellow half white gold split down the middle, bottom all yellow, 14k everything, all solid
cases.tests: left/right split metal on one arch — FLAG: override keys need left_side/right_side added to the schema, parser must not average it into one metal

cases.prompt: i want what trax has, the 8 bottom iced with the blue diamonds
cases.tests: competitor reference carries no metal; colored diamond variant in stones — FLAG: enum needs blue_diamond

cases.prompt: 6 top 6 bottom all 10k yellow BUT the bottom is open face and the top is solid, and only the top gets diamonds
cases.tests: shared attributes stated first, then per-arch splits; diamonds must not leak to the open-face bottom

cases.prompt: just 2 teeth. the fangs. white gold, and i want emeralds in them
cases.tests: Emerald's actual stone list includes emeralds in other jewelers' mouths — stones on a fang finish; white gold defaults 10k

cases.prompt: make me a set like, top 6 solid gold no stones, bottom 6 with every tooth a different stone if thats possible
cases.tests: 'every tooth a different stone' cannot be one stones array value per tooth in this schema — correct behavior: stones:['multi'] placeholder or FLAG for clarification; gold defaults yellow 10k — FLAG both

cases.prompt: 8x8 platinum, iced out top, bottom solid, and engrave 'M' on the bottom front left
cases.tests: engraving content given this time, scoped to bottom only; 8x8 shorthand with per-arch finishes

expected.flag: two separate customers in one prompt — parser should flag that this is two orders, and parse the shared spec once: top 6, 10k_rose, opal_inlay, opal stones

cases.prompt: so my girl wants matching sets with me, both of us top 6 rose gold opals
cases.tests: validation case: quantity of PEOPLE is not quantity of teeth; flag rather than doubling the teeth

expected.flag: contradiction + vague degree: metal changed mid-prompt (silver -> gold, take the LAST instruction), 'not too icy' has no config value — parser should apply gold + iced_out and flag the vague part, or ask

cases.prompt: bottom 6 silver but actually make it gold. and iced. but not too icy
cases.tests: self-correction inside one message; last instruction wins; vague qualifiers get flagged not invented

expected.flag: no parseable spec at all — correct behavior is flag/ask, never hallucinate a maxed-out config

cases.prompt: i want the most expensive one you got, everything, surprise me
cases.tests: anti-hallucination: zero concrete attributes given

cases.prompt: top 6 14k yellow solid. wait sorry top 8. and make it white gold
cases.tests: chat-style corrections: later values replace earlier ones for count AND metal, karat carries over

cases.prompt: do u ship to canada?? also bottom four in silver open face pls
cases.tests: question noise around a real order; the shipping question is ignored by the parser (not a config field), order still parsed

cases.prompt: 6 by 6 but like NOT gold, the other one, and the see-through style on the bottoms only
cases.tests: circumlocution: 'the other one' = silver, 'see-through style' = open face — FLAG: these two mappings are judgment calls, Haleem to confirm

cases.prompt: how much for 10 top 10 bottom all diamonds vvs
cases.tests: price question that still contains a full spec; VVS is a diamond grade — FLAG: grade not in schema, parser should note it, not drop the order

cases.prompt: top 6: laterals open face, centrals solid with a star cutout on the left central, canines fangs, all 14k yellow
cases.tests: full per-tooth specification using anatomical names; three different finishes inside one arch

expected.flag: depends on conversation history the parser may not have — correct behavior: flag missing context rather than inventing the previous order

cases.prompt: just redo my last order but swap the top to rose gold and add fangs
cases.tests: context-dependence: an honest parser says what it needs

expected.flag: all-pointed bottoms is not the standard fang finish (canines only) — parser should flag the non-standard request instead of silently mapping it to fang canines or solid

cases.prompt: bottoms only. 8 teeth. i want em to look like vampire fangs but like, all of them pointed
cases.tests: plausible-sounding request outside the product's real options; flag, don't force-fit

arch.extras: array, e.g. engraving, color_coat:pink, cross_cutout, star_cutout, heart_cutout
arch.finish: solid | open_face | iced_out | opal_inlay | window | fang | diamond_dust
arch.overrides: per-tooth changes keyed by tooth: front_two | canine_left | canine_right | lateral_left | lateral_right | back_teeth
arch.stones: array of diamond | opal | ruby | emerald | sapphire
arch.teeth: number of teeth covered, counted from the front center outward, both sides combined (6 = front 3 left + front 3 right)

schema.null_arch: an arch not mentioned in the prompt must come back null, never invented
